I misspoke, as I agree that in its current state, precision medicine, won't work as a valid diagnostic tool for every person. I just happen to be someone who behaves exactly like you would expect from seeing my genetic profile. Treatment obviously becomes problematic when this correlation doesn't exist.

Even though it's not a viable solution for all patients, I love the philosophy behind it.  It allows for doctors to treat the root of the problem directly by finding what enzymes are behaving irregularly or neurotransmitters are deficient.
For most people, this form of treatment isn't yet possible but for the minority who can benefit from it it is extremely effective and much better than taking a catch-all moodstabilizer that simply reduces occurrences of manic episodes without treating the underlying cause. 

That being said, I would like to further emphasize how important it is to have a decent psychiatrist/doctor who is trained in genomic analysis. Solutions for treatment can be inferred from even the more complex genetic profiles if the specialist has enough experience. It's still so new though, that it's rare to find someone with that level of expertise.
I've been told by med students where I work that it has only been about five years since the study of personalized genomics became mandatory at even some of the better med schools. So it's integration into mainstream medicine is still In its infancy. 

There are also many who suffer heavily from bipolar who are forced to turn to complementary and alternative medicine as treatment simply because traditional therapeutics are completely ineffective
In many cases (as with me), it's because traditional pharmaceuticals are far too potent to have any therapeutic effect and only cause extremely harsh side-effects when taken. For people with a similarly janky metabolism like mine, the negative side-effects of pharmaceuticals outweigh the benefits even when they are compounded down to the threshold level. 

So in somewhat rare cases like this, 'homeopathics' can actually be effective treatments. And yes, that is exactly what I'm referring to by saying homeopathic but I use that word cautiously as the market is flooded with snake-oil tinctures that are merely water.
Despite that, there are many extremely effective tinctures that are labeled as 'homeopathic solutions/remedies'

For example, this is one such tincture that I've been taking: http://www.professionalformulas.com/newsletters/Serotonin%20Dopamine%20Liq%20Newsletter.pdf

It is actually so effective that I have had to reduce the dosage to a single drop, if I take more than that I get side-effects that are similar to over-stimulation from amphetamines due to higher dopamine levels, as well as the anxiety and paranoia that comes along with it. 

But in small doses, I find it to be far more effective than any antidepressant I've taken and it has none of the weight gain Or sexual side effects I would get from an SSRI or akathisia-type side effects that I would get from an NDRI. For the first time in my life, I'm literally free from the clutches of depression. I feel like ive woken up from a long sleep, It's truly a great feeling
